invariants.name: predecessor_count_invariant
invariants.description: For each node v, the recursively constructed ordering of its subtree nodes maintains the invariant that exactly c_v descendants appear before v, ensuring that when assigning strictly increasing values to the ordering, a_v is greater than exactly c_v descendants.

invariants.name: valid_c_range
invariants.description: For any node v, the value c_v must satisfy 0 <= c_v <= size(subtree(v))-1; the algorithm checks this and reports NO if violated.
